    Profile

    Matia is a warrior of the the Gluttony Layer and one of the first citizens of Sephira. She takes the side of those unable to defend themselves, both out of compassion, and out of a desire to fight stronger opponents. She lets her blade do the talking, choosing to live her life on the battlefield. She is so fond of battle that many have taken to calling her blood-crazed.

    Origin: Gluttony Layer
    Gender: Female
    Height: 153cm
    Weight: 40kg
    Birthday: Dec 14
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Nightmare Cherry Blossom
    Likes: Surpassing others
    Hobbies: Fighting strong opponents
    Illust: RINZO（G-ROW）
    CV: 稲垣好
